dependsOn: Three independent exact-live Eat baseline reviews at public 07c366d, unchanged Eat/search/popup source in later consent-only release 9229c13.
owner: Codex in James-approved Peninsula Insider task
finding: The search overlay sets aria-modal and data-open but synchronous input.focus can run while its CSS visibility has not changed, leaving Tab on underlying masthead controls. A scroll-triggered Insider Note can then open over search after 1.5 seconds and steal focus; one Escape closes both. Clearing an Eat zero-result directory state removes the focused button and leaves focus on BODY.
hypothesis: Making search visible before synchronous input focus, containing any Tab that starts outside it, and suppressing the promotional popup while another dialog or search is active will restore one active keyboard surface. Returning focus to the directory heading after clearing filters will make recovered results discoverable.
boundedChange: Make the search overlay visible on open before focusing its input, and redirect an outside Tab into the overlay. Let the topmost Insider Note own Escape if it is open, and keep its automatic invite from opening over active search or native dialogs. Restore focus to the directory heading after clearing an empty state. Do not change search results, filters, email submission, analytics consent or bookings.
metric: At 320/390/1440, opening search by Enter or Search instead moves focus into the input; Tab and Shift+Tab stay within the open search, and Escape closes it and restores its opener. Scroll and the 20-second fallback do not open Insider Note over active search or native dialog; if the invite is open, one Escape closes only it. On the exact 0/52 Eat URL, Clear filters restores 52 results and focuses the directory heading. Existing filter/search journeys and no-overflow layout remain intact. Full build and independent browser QA pass; exact public SHA/browser accept release.
rollback: Revert this bounded shared-interaction commit; no data migration or booking/consent endpoint change.
